India criticizes Pakistan's actions on Masood Azhar

India has criticized Pakistan's recent actions concerning Masood Azhar, calling them a "new drama" and "new tactic." The Ministry of External Affairs stated that Pakistan should "stop throwing dust in the eyes of the world" and urged them to "arrest now, not do drama." This statement was made in response to Pakistan's handling of the Masood Azhar issue.
